description.value: Northern Lights Restaurant is a sit-down restaurant on northern Vancouver Island, operating under the evocative tagline 'Dine Under the Borealis.' It sits in a stretch of the Island Highway corridor that sees long-distance cycle tourists heading toward Port Hardy and the BC Ferries terminal. Its website offers almost no detail about the experience, leaving the specifics of cuisine and atmosphere undocumented.
